answer: Seeded duty assignment. A public beacon emits unpredictable seeds after each enrollment window; agents receive tasks like relaying an ember shipment or verifying a sparrow sighting, and only agents whose seed-derived slot matches may act as a bridge between clusters. Attacker must enroll many identities before seeing the seed, pay real compute and gas to keep every slot live, then watch most slots go unused, so each useful sybil costs far more than the reward.
